title: Cohomology of punctured generalization neighborhoods as a filtered colimit
statement: Let $T$ be a spectral topological space [def-weil-spectral-space], let $Z\subseteq T$ be closed with quasi-compact open complement $U=T\setminus Z$, and let $A$ be a sheaf of abelian groups on $T$. Set $W=\{t\in T:\overline{\{t\}}\cap Z\ne\varnothing\}$ and $S=W\setminus Z$, with their subspace topologies. For a subspace $B\subseteq T$, write $A|_B$ for the inverse image along its inclusion [def-weil-pbc-topological-inverse-image]. For every integer $p\geq0$ the canonical restriction maps induce an isomorphism of abelian groups $$\varinjlim_{Z\subseteq N\subseteq T,\ N\text{ quasi-compact open}} H^p(N\setminus Z,A|_{N\setminus Z})\ \xrightarrow{\ \sim\ }\ H^p(S,A|_S).$$ Here cohomology is the right-derived global sections of abelian sheaves [def-sc-topological-abelian-cohomology], and the colimit [def-weil-pbc-category-colimit] is over the set of quasi-compact open neighborhoods $N$ of $Z$, ordered by reverse inclusion, with restriction transition maps. This index set is nonempty (it contains $T$) and directed (intersections are quasi-compact open).
